sections.kicker: Prepared for House of Palatini's by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: House of Palatini's has a story no other scoop shop can tell. Right now it sits in the middle of the bio.
sections.keep: Your bio line, "bringing joy, wonder & everyone to the table". It sounds like a host, not a shop.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.what: The one thing nobody else can claim sits halfway through your bio.
pins.why: West African flavor is the answer to why you and not the next ice cream shop, and people read it last.
pins.how: Lead with it: name the flavors and where they come from before you say scoops or cookies.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: People skim the first words, file you as another dessert shop, and move on.

pins.what: The line under the name could belong to any bakery.
pins.why: A name line is the fastest read you get, and this one says nothing only you can say.
pins.how: Give that line one specific word of flavor or origin.
pins.label: Your name
pins.cost: Every first glance ends at a phrase people have seen before.

pins.quote: We're under construction. Please check back for an update soon.
pins.what: Anyone who looks you up finds an empty page.
pins.why: A blank site tells a curious person there is no brand here yet.
pins.how: Even one page with the story and three flavors would carry the idea.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: The people your posts reach have nowhere to learn more.

sections.intro: You said people do not get it fast enough. I looked at your Instagram and your site, and the fix is already written. It is just in the wrong place.
